$schema_note: Machine-readable companion to context/crosswalks/breach-notification-timelines.md. The markdown carries the nuance; this file carries the clocks for tooling (scripts/deadline_calc.py, the MCP server). Every regime here must have a row in the markdown matrix — the validator enforces name-level sync. Deadline types: hours | days (calendar) | business_days (Mon-Fri, not holiday-aware) | calendar_months | text (no computable offset). 'basis' names the event whose timestamp starts that clock; different regimes define different trigger events on purpose.
$verification: Reflects public sources as of mid-2026; verify against official texts before filing. Last reviewed: 2026-07.

regimes.name: EU GDPR Art. 33/34
regimes.notifier: Controller (processor notifies the controller without undue delay)

deadlines.label: Art. 33(1) supervisory authority notification
deadlines.notes: Calendar hours; phased notification permitted with reasons; exempt if unlikely to result in risk

deadlines.label: Art. 33(2) processor-to-controller notice
deadlines.notes: DPA clauses commonly specify 24-48h

deadlines.label: Art. 34 data subject notification
deadlines.notes: Only when likely high risk; encryption exemption Art. 34(3)(a)

deadlines.label: Early warning
deadlines.notes: Thin by design: suspected malicious cause, cross-border impact

deadlines.label: Incident notification
deadlines.notes: Initial assessment, severity, impact, IoCs

deadlines.label: Final report
deadlines.notes: One month from the incident notification; member-state portals vary

deadlines.label: Initial report
deadlines.notes: 4h from classification as major AND no later than 24h from awareness - timelines set by RTS, verify

deadlines.label: Initial report outer bound
deadlines.notes: Outer bound per RTS - verify

deadlines.label: Intermediate report
deadlines.notes: Per RTS - verify

deadlines.label: Final report
deadlines.notes: Per RTS - verify

regimes.name: US HIPAA Breach Notification Rule
regimes.notifier: Covered entity (BA notifies CE within 60 days of discovery)

deadlines.label: Individual notification
deadlines.notes: 'Without unreasonable delay' is the operative standard; 60 days is the outer limit; discovery is imputed

deadlines.label: HHS notification (>=500)
deadlines.notes: Contemporaneous with individual notice for 500+ breaches; media if >500 residents of one state

deadlines.label: HHS annual log (<500)
deadlines.notes: Within 60 days after the calendar year end

deadlines.label: 8-K Item 1.05 filing
deadlines.notes: Clock starts at the materiality DETERMINATION, which must be made without unreasonable delay - not at detection

deadlines.label: Resident notification
deadlines.value: most expedient time, without unreasonable delay; specific outer bounds commonly 30-60 days
deadlines.recipient: Affected residents; many states AG/regulator above thresholds
deadlines.notes: Per-state grid required - definitions and clocks vary

deadlines.label: FTC notification
deadlines.notes: Notification event: unencrypted customer information of >=500 consumers

deadlines.label: Regulator notification
deadlines.notes: Clock starts at determination a notification incident occurred; operational disruption standard, no personal data required

deadlines.label: Cybersecurity event notice
deadlines.notes: From determination of a reportable event

deadlines.label: Extortion payment notice
deadlines.notes: If a payment is made

deadlines.label: Extortion payment explanation
deadlines.notes: Written explanation of necessity and alternatives considered

deadlines.label: Covered cyber incident report
deadlines.notes: Rule status and covered-entity criteria: verify current status before relying

deadlines.label: Ransom payment report
deadlines.notes: Verify rule status

regimes.name: EU Cyber Resilience Act (manufacturer reporting)
regimes.jurisdiction: EU (manufacturers of products with digital elements)

deadlines.label: Early warning (actively exploited vulnerability / severe incident)
deadlines.notes: Product-defect reporting, different trigger nature than victim-entity duties

deadlines.label: Vulnerability/incident notification
deadlines.notes: Verify final report cadence (14 days / 1 month by case) against official text

deadlines.label: ICO notification
deadlines.notes: Separate filing from any EU authority - no one-stop-shop across the Channel

deadlines.label: Material control weakness notification
deadlines.notes: Weaknesses that cannot be remediated in a timely manner

regimes.name: Australia Notifiable Data Breaches scheme
regimes.notifier: Entities covered by the Privacy Act

deadlines.label: Eligibility assessment
deadlines.notes: Complete the assessment within 30 days if eligibility is unclear

deadlines.label: Significant-impact incident report
deadlines.notes: Verify impact categories

deadlines.label: PDPC notification
deadlines.notes: 3 calendar days from determining the breach is notifiable; the preceding assessment must itself be expeditious (~30 days guidance)

deadlines.label: Individual notification
deadlines.notes: Where significant harm likely

deadlines.label: Incident notification
deadlines.notes: Relevant IT security incident or major system malfunction

deadlines.label: Initial report
deadlines.notes: Prompt initial report - PPC guidance indicates roughly 3-5 days, verify

deadlines.label: Final report
deadlines.notes: 60 days for wrongful-intent incident classes

deadlines.label: Individual + PIPC notification
deadlines.notes: Verify current Enforcement Decree thresholds

deadlines.label: Data principal notification
deadlines.notes: No statutory harm threshold - assume notifiable by default; verify final Rules

deadlines.label: Board report
deadlines.notes: Per Rules, extendable on request - verify

regimes.name: India CERT-In directions
regimes.notifier: Service providers, intermediaries, companies operating in India

deadlines.label: Incident report
deadlines.notes: Specified incident types (20-item list); among the world's tightest clocks

deadlines.label: Regulator + individual notification
deadlines.recipient: CAC or sector regulator + affected individuals
deadlines.notes: Individual notice waivable if harm effectively avoided unless ordered; incident-reporting measures push severe incidents to hour-scale windows - verify

deadlines.label: ANPD + data subject notification
deadlines.notes: Per ANPD 2024 incident-reporting regulation; incidents with relevant risk or damage

deadlines.label: OPC report + individual notification
deadlines.notes: Real risk of significant harm standard; keep records of ALL breaches for 24 months

deadlines.label: CAI + affected persons notification
deadlines.notes: Confidentiality incident presenting risk of serious injury; incident register mandatory

deadlines.label: Acquirer + card brand notification
deadlines.notes: Contractual, not statutory; treat as same-day
